custom_logic_notes: The core trading logic is entirely encapsulated in the CH_HM_Stoch custom signal filter class from ACH_HM_Stoch.mqh. The EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework (CExpert/CExpertSignal) which manages signal aggregation, threshold-based entry (open>=40) and exit (close<=20), pending order creation with 4-bar expiration, and position management. The signal weight is 1.0 meaning this is the sole filter. Expert_EveryTick=false means signal evaluation happens once per bar, not every tick. SL/TP are both 0 meaning the framework relies entirely on signal-based exits or the reverse signal for closing.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACH_HM_Stoch.mqh to extract the actual entry/exit signal generation logic (LongCondition/ShortCondition methods). The Stochastic params are (K=15, D=49, Slowing=25, LOWHIGH) plus an MA period=15. The CExpertSignal threshold mechanism: open when |signal|>=40, close when |signal|<=20. The EA processes on new bar only (EveryTick=false). No SL/TP means exits are purely signal-driven. Pending orders expire after 4 bars. CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed 0.1 lots with 10% margin allocation. The framework handles position checking internally - no explicit stacking logic visible in EA code, default CExpert behavior is one position at a time per symbol/magic.
